critical_code_review_comments: Phase 4 CSS specificity fix is good: wrapping .card-soft in @layer components allows Tailwind utilities (border-[#F25C05]) to win on border-color. Worth applying the same @layer components pattern to other shared component classes in index.css (e.g. .form-input) to avoid future Tailwind override surprises.
Backend ContactInquiry endpoints persist and serialize cleanly (use {'_id': 0} projection, ISO timestamps). EmailStr validation correctly rejects bad emails with 422. No issues.
/api/contact-inquiries currently has no auth or rate limiting — fine for a public lead form, but adding a basic abuse guard (per-IP throttle / honeypot) before production is recommended.

/app/frontend/src/pages/HowItWorksPage.jsx, AboutPage.jsx and FAQPage.jsx have well-organised constants (TIMELINE, INLINE_FAQS, FAQS, etc.). HowItWorksPage is fairly long — if more content is added consider extracting the timeline + inline FAQ blocks into sub-components.

rca of the issue: FAQ count gap RCA: FAQS array in /app/frontend/src/pages/FAQPage.jsx lines 16-45 contains 5 plans + 5 delivery + 4 products + 4 feeder + 4 account = 22 entries. The request spec stated 23 across 5 categories. Either spec is off by one or one item was dropped. Mitigation: append one additional question object (e.g. another 'products' or 'feeder' entry) so total reaches 23.
